title: How Much Do Coding Agents Over-Edit, and Why? An Empirical Study of Unneeded Edits in Repository-Level Agent Patches
abstract: arXiv:2611.34875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent patches are larger than developers', which is widely read as over-editing. But patch size does not say whether the extra edits are needed, what they are, or where they come from. We introduce Delta Residue Attribution (DRA), which replays agent trajectories, traces every block (unit) of the final patch to the step that wrote it, reverts each unit, and reruns the task tests to decide whether the unit is needed. We apply DRA to 7,660 resolved GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories from 18 frontier models on SWE-bench Verified (6,728) and DeepSWE (932), and grade developer patches using the same method. Agent patches do change more lines than developers'; on SWE-bench Verified the majority of extra edits add tests (61%) and documentation (13%) while on DeepSWE, most extra edits are code (58%). translated_title: 编码代理的过度编辑有多少，原因何在？关于仓库级代理补丁中不必要编辑的实证研究
translated_abstract: 代理补丁比开发者的更大，这被广泛解读为过度编辑。但补丁大小并不能说明额外的编辑是否必要、它们是什么、或它们来自哪里。我们提出了Delta残留归因（DRA）方法，该方法重放代理轨迹，将最终补丁的每个块（单元）追溯到写入它的步骤，回滚每个单元，并重新运行任务测试以判断该单元是否必要。我们将DRA应用于来自18个前沿模型在SWE-bench Verified（6,728条）和DeepSWE（932条）上的7,660条已解决的GitHub Copilot CLI轨迹，并用相同方法对开发者补丁进行评级。代理补丁确实比开发者的更改更多行；在SWE-bench Verified上，大多数额外编辑是增加测试（61%）和文档（13%），而在DeepSWE上，大多数额外编辑是代码（58%）。在两个基准测试上，代理的代码平均而言至少与开发者的代码一样必要（在SWE-bench Verified上平均NP_code为0.887对比0.864，其中1表示全部必要）……
tldr: 该论文提出了Delta残留归因（DRA）方法，通过重放代理轨迹、逐单元回滚补丁并重跑测试来判定每个编辑的必要性，实证发现编码代理的代码编辑平均必要性与开发者相当，其“过度编辑”主要源于额外添加的测试和文档而非冗余代码。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Delta Residue Attribution (DRA), which replays agent trajectories, reverts each patch unit, and reruns tests to assess its necessity, empirically showing that coding agents' code edits are on average as necessary as developers', with "over-editing" mainly stemming from added tests and documentation rather than redundant code.
